question: Which of the following is a tributary of the Indus river?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Beas is a tributary of the Indus river.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The river Beas originates in the **Beas Kund, near Rohtang pass in Himachal Pradesh**, at the height of 4361mt above sea level.
 
• It is one of the five rivers that give **Punjab** (“Five Rivers”) its name.
 
• the Beas enters Punjab state and moves south and then southwest to its confluence with the **Satluj** river at **Harike .**
 
• The other major tributaries of the Indus River in India are **Jhelum, Ravi, Chenab, and Sutlej.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• Son is the second-largest southern tributary of the Ganga.
 
• **Subansiri **a right-bank tributary of the **Brahmaputra **flows in **Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• **Jonk **is a tributary of Mahanadi.
